text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Government tells Brussels that 1995 public sector deficit was under five pct, down from the 5.2 percent previously estimated, according to an official source.
- Some companies and individuals may pay less tax in 1997, Secretary of State for Taxation Carlos Santos says.
- State carrier TAP lost 5.3 billion escudos Jan-August, 3.2 billion escudos less than in the same period in 1995.
- Banking group Banco Mello Comercial is studying a telephone banking project to start January 1, 1997.
- Quinta da Aveleda shareholders reject six billion escudo takeover bid by wine company Sogrape.
- Self-employed workers and businessmen who allegedly never make a profit and so pay no tax could be forced to pay a tax calculated by the government.
- Banco Mello de Investimentos will leave Lisbon's stock exchange this week and the group will continue to reduce the number of workers.
